content.goal: Build an ESP32 + MPU6050 vibration monitor that streams acceleration telemetry and verifies stationary accel_x RMS noise stays below 0.10 g.
content.problemStatement: Stationary IMU noise must be quantified and verified against an explicit RMS threshold using reproducible Analysis outputs.
content.intendedContext: Embedded systems prototype using ESP32 DevKit and MPU6050 over I2C (SDA GPIO21, SCL GPIO22) with serial telemetry at 115200 baud.
scope: ESP32 communicates with MPU6050 over I2C on GPIO21/GPIO22
Firmware initializes serial 115200 and reports readiness
Machine-readable telemetry: time_ms, accel_x_g, accel_y_g, accel_z_g
Analysis verifies demeaned accel_x RMS noise < 0.10 g and emits JSON/CSV/PNG
successCriteria: Requirements R1–R8 are consistent across architecture, firmware, and analysis
Firmware compiles offline in the pinned PlatformIO image
Analysis produces summary.json, processed.csv, accel_plot.png with deterministic R7 PASS

assumptions.statement: Golden stationary dataset is representative of bench-idle IMU noise.
